Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class IconGlyphLibrary

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.IconGlyphLibrary
public final class IconGlyphLibrary extends Object
A never-throw bridge over the bundled IconManager glyph library (libs/IconManager-1.6.0.jar) for the icon-pack builder: it enumerates the glyph catalogue by category and renders one glyph to a BufferedImage so IconPackManager.saveUserPack(java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.awt.image.BufferedImage>) can persist it as a PNG in a user pack.

IconManager ships its toolbar glyphs only at 16 and 24 px and enumerates them as "<Name><edge>.gif" file names, so this class reduces those to distinct base glyph names (the vocabulary IconManager.loadIcon expects) and loads at a bundled edge before resizing to the requested size. A MissingIcon - the red-X placeholder IconManager returns for an unknown name - is treated as "no glyph" and mapped to null.

IconManager is a compile-only dependency placed on the desktop run classpath by the build. Every entry point catches Throwable (a NoClassDefFoundError when the jar is absent) and degrades to an empty catalogue / null, so the control center still opens and the pack list keeps working when the library is missing.

    • searchGlyphs

      public static Map<com.protonmail.landrevillejf.IconManager.IconCategory,List<String>> searchGlyphs(String query)
      Searches the whole catalogue for glyph base names matching query, grouped by category (in categories() order). Reduces IconManager's "<Name><edge>.gif" hits to the distinct base names loadIcon(com.protonmail.landrevillejf.IconManager.IconCategory, java.lang.String, int) expects. Empty when the query is blank, the library is absent, or nothing matches.

    • render

      public static BufferedImage render(IconRecipe recipe, int size)
      Renders recipe into a square BufferedImage of size, or null when nothing could be drawn. This is the studio's single entry point: it builds the source (a glyph or a generative tile) then runs the appearance chain - tint, rounded corners, drop shadow, IconManager.IconEffects, brightness/contrast, rotation and flip - degrading gracefully (never throwing) if IconManager is absent or any one step fails.

    • renderIcon

      public static Icon renderIcon(IconRecipe recipe, int size)
      Renders recipe to a styled Icon at size, or null when the source cannot be resolved. Each appearance step is individually guarded so a single unsupported effect cannot blank the icon.
